category_name: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
title: When receiving something that pleases you - Hisn al-Muslim 218
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
translation: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected.
description: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication.
reference: Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.

category_name: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
title: When receiving something that displeases you - Hisn al-Muslim 218
translation: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
description: When something happened that displeased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this supplication.
reference: Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.
